Italian Prime Minister Meloni Highlights Coalition Strength at Bari Rally

Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni addressed a rally in Bari, emphasizing her government's longevity. She noted that the coalition has remained in power longer than most post‑war Italian administrations and indicated that a national election is planned for 2027. France 24 reported that analysts view the coalition’s strength as stemming more from the dominant position of Meloni’s party within the governing alliance than from specific policy achievements. Euronews added that such durability of a coalition is rare in Italy’s post‑war history. No further policy details or opposition reactions were reported in the coverage.
